final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id COLLATE BINARY = b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.event_name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount FROM event_averages) SELECT ea.event_name, ea.average_amount, ea.average_amount - oa.average_amount AS difference, ea.average_amount / oa.average_amount AS ratio FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oa.average_amount IS NOT NULL AND ea.average_amount > oa.average_amount
